class.name: IfcColumn
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO 6707-1:1989 : Structural member of slender form, usually vertical, that transmits to its base the forces, primarily in compression, that are applied to it. IfcColumn is a vertical structural member which often is aligned with a structural grid intersection.
